name: session-decisions
description: Keeps the decisions and actions an assistant is waiting on you for in the session task list: numbered D1, A1, ..., checked for a recommendation and a link, re-shown after compaction, and shown as cards in the transcript and a sidebar, with a count in the footer.

forge_hosts.title: Forge hosts
forge_hosts.description: Forges the plugin can't tell from the host name, as host=kind entries split by commas; kind is github, gitlab, forgejo or gitea. For example: git.lab.example.com=forgejo, code.example.com=gitlab. An entry here wins over the built-in rules for its host.

handoff_check.title: Hand-off check
handoff_check.description: When a reply hands you work ("left for you", "you'll need to merge") that isn't in the decision queue, or a shell command line too wide to copy out of tmux whole, show a warning and remind the assistant on its next turn.

ignore_labels.title: Labels the hand-off check ignores
ignore_labels.description: Labels that name something else in your work, split by commas, such as D1 for Cloudflare D1. The hand-off check never reports these as named but not in the queue. Leave empty to check every label.

reply_list.title: Reply list
reply_list.description: When the assistant ends its replies with a one-line-per-item list of the open decisions and actions: auto (while you write over Remote Control, from the mobile app or claude.ai/code, where the pane doesn't show), always, or never. /decisions list on, off or auto changes it for one session.

push_notifications.title: Push notifications
push_notifications.description: Push each new decision or action to your phone (label, question, recommendation), and again when its recommendation changes. Uses Claude Code's PushNotification tool, which pushes while Remote Control is connected and "Push when Claude decides" is on in /config.
